Subject: Request for Full Refund – Defective Plumbing Work

Dear Top End Plumbing Services,

I am writing to request a full refund for a recent plumbing job carried out at my home in Darwin. The work was booked under my name, Elena Harding, using the email address elena.harding@nt.gov.au and phone number +61-8-5550-2147, and was completed around 1 December 2025. The total I paid for this job was approximately $320, via card.

The job involved fixing a leak under my kitchen sink. Unfortunately, the leak was not repaired properly and the pipe was still dripping the following day. I then engaged a second licensed plumber to investigate and fix the issue. They advised me that the original install/repair had been done poorly and needed to be redone. I was charged $280 by the second plumber to correct this.

Given that:
- The original problem (a leaking pipe under the sink) was not resolved by your visit, and  
- A subsequent professional has confirmed that the initial work was substandard and had to be redone at additional cost to me,

I consider the original service to have failed to meet a reasonable standard of care and skill. On that basis, I am requesting a full refund of the $320 I paid for the first job.

I am happy to provide:
- The second plumber’s invoice for $280, and  
- Any written notes or statements from them regarding the quality of the original work,  
- As well as photos of the issue if needed.

Please confirm in writing within 7 business days that you will process a full refund of $320 back to the original card used for payment, and advise the timeline for the funds to appear in my account.

I would prefer to resolve this matter directly with you, but if needed I am prepared to escalate the issue through consumer affairs with the supporting documentation.

I look forward to your prompt response.

Kind regards,  
Elena Harding  
Email: elena.harding@nt.gov.au  
Phone: +61-8-5550-2147</action>
